name: mifit
description: Your own Mi Fitness (Xiaomi) health data for Claude: sleep, heart rate, steps, workouts. Read-only.
long_description: Unofficial: not affiliated with Xiaomi. mifit reads your own Mi Fitness data from the Xiaomi cloud when you ask Claude about it ("how did I sleep last week?"). The results of its tools go to Claude's model provider, like the rest of the chat. Your login stays in ~/.mifit on this computer. If you are not logged in, ask Claude to log you in: it shows a QR code (login_start) to scan with the Xiaomi or Mi Fitness app. GPS routes are off unless you turn on Allow GPS tracks, and a route shows where you were, including where you live.

allow_gps.title: Allow GPS tracks
allow_gps.description: Let Claude read a workout's GPS route when you ask for it. A route shows where you were, including where you live. Off by default.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Today's date, the time zone, the login state, the GPS setting (nothing from the cloud)

tools.name: get_calories
tools.description: Calories per day: resting, active, intake, total

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: Activity count, minutes and calories per day

tools.name: get_heart_rate_daily
tools.description: Heart rate per day: average, maximum, minimum, resting

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Sleep per day with its sessions; stage timelines on request

tools.name: get_stress_daily
tools.description: Stress level per day and the minutes in each stress band

tools.name: get_workout_detail
tools.description: One workout's per-second samples (outdoor runs and rides), and its GPS track with Allow GPS tracks on

tools.name: login_start
tools.description: Log in by QR code (returns the code)
